entries.normative_statement: This specification SHALL NOT redefine Runtime-owned object layouts, pool mechanics or resource-management algorithms.
entries.applicability_rationale: Specification authority boundaries govern the M0 foundation; verify that IR metadata does not redefine Runtime layouts or mechanics.

entries.normative_statement: This register SHALL NOT invent numerical values merely to eliminate an unresolved decision.
entries.applicability_rationale: The M0 limit derivation must not manufacture numerical constants to conceal unresolved engineering or authority decisions.

entries.normative_statement: UNRESOLVED SHALL mean that a decision remains unresolved; it SHALL NOT mean that runtime behaviour may be unbounded.
entries.applicability_rationale: M0 registry interpretation must distinguish an unresolved decision from an enforceable unbounded runtime allowance.

entries.normative_statement: Capacity, work, rate and deadline limits SHALL NOT be treated as interchangeable controls.
entries.applicability_rationale: The M0 register and effective-limit evaluation must retain distinct semantics for capacity, work, rate and deadline quantities.

entries.normative_statement: An effective limit SHALL NOT exceed an applicable hard protocol, platform, provider, build or dependency constraint.
entries.applicability_rationale: M0 configuration and capacity derivation must not exceed applicable hard build, platform or dependency constraints.

entries.normative_statement: A non-applicable limit SHALL NOT be treated as unresolved.
entries.applicability_rationale: M0 applicability evaluation must distinguish a demonstrably non-applicable limit from an unresolved applicable limit.

entries.normative_statement: The Effective Limit Manifest SHALL include the applicable subset for the identified build/configuration.
entries.applicability_rationale: The M0 Effective Limit Manifest must select applicable entries for the identified binary and configuration, once authoritative.

entries.normative_statement: A standards-derived limit SHALL NOT rely solely on undocumented institutional memory for its origin.
entries.applicability_rationale: Any standards-derived limit asserted by M0 must carry traceable provenance rather than depend on undocumented assumptions.

entries.normative_statement: advertised_capacity ≤ configured_capacity
entries.applicability_rationale: Investigate whether the M0 registry or startup configuration advertises capacities, and if so verify advertised versus configured.

entries.normative_statement: ordinary_usable_capacity + protected_reserves ≤ physical_capacity
entries.applicability_rationale: Investigate whether M0 provisioned storage implements protected reserves, and if so reconcile ordinary and reserve capacities.

entries.normative_statement: A rate value without defined interval/window semantics SHALL NOT constitute a complete enforceable rate limit.
entries.applicability_rationale: Rate limiting requires an interval model; first mandatory scope depends on when an enforceable runtime rate limit is introduced.

entries.normative_statement: A rational threshold SHALL define exact operands and rounding semantics.
entries.applicability_rationale: A rational-threshold evaluator needs exact operand and rounding semantics; inspect M0 registry features before assigning ownership.

entries.normative_statement: An accepted H1 request SHALL have one unambiguous framing interpretation.
entries.applicability_rationale: Unambiguous HTTP/1 request framing becomes mandatory when HTTP/1 request acceptance is implemented, not merely at bootstrap.

entries.normative_statement: Peer-advertised/requested values SHALL NOT force AsmWeb beyond effective provisioned capacity.
entries.applicability_rationale: HTTP/2 peer-driven capacity enforcement becomes mandatory with HTTP/2 admission and protocol support.

entries.normative_statement: HPACK dynamic state SHALL remain within its authoritative memory bound.
entries.applicability_rationale: HPACK dynamic-table storage applies once the HTTP/2 header compression implementation is present.

entries.normative_statement: HPACK decoding SHALL remain within semantic-output and work limits.
entries.applicability_rationale: HPACK decoding output and work bounds apply when HPACK decoding becomes an implemented protocol feature.

entries.normative_statement: Unknown but permitted H3 frames SHALL remain resource-accounted.
entries.applicability_rationale: Unknown permitted HTTP/3 frame accounting depends on the HTTP/3 frame-processing implementation.

entries.normative_statement: QPACK blocked-stream state SHALL remain bounded.
entries.applicability_rationale: QPACK blocked-stream state is relevant when HTTP/3 QPACK blocked-stream processing is introduced.

entries.normative_statement: QPACK table state SHALL remain bounded.
entries.applicability_rationale: QPACK table-state bounds are relevant to an implemented HTTP/3 QPACK dynamic table.

entries.normative_statement: QPACK decoding SHALL remain within semantic-output and work limits.
entries.applicability_rationale: QPACK decoding work and semantic-output bounds apply when HTTP/3 QPACK decoding becomes available.
